description: Everything Keelage holds on one Robinhood Chain token, as the token page shows it: the launch (creator, factory, template, block and time), today's price, cap, pool, volume and holders, the structural verdict the scan last recorded, every alert raised on it with its 24-hour, 7-day and 30-day outcome, the hourly price series, what X showed by day, and a dated log of what changed. Free, never counted. Hosted server only: the local server has no store and says so.

address.description: Token contract address on Robinhood Chain (0x + 40 hex characters).
